cases.title: Initial page load displays first question and unchecked options
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the Quiz App webpage, the first question and four unchecked radio buttons with corresponding labels are automatically displayed using the correct data-testids.

cases.title: Mutual exclusivity of radio button selection
cases.description: Verify that users can select only one answer option at a time via radio buttons, and clicking multiple options rapidly maintains mutual exclusivity.

cases.title: Submit button behavior when no answer is selected
cases.description: Verify that clicking the submit button without selecting any answer does not advance the quiz or change the current question display.

cases.title: Submit button behavior when an answer is selected
cases.description: Verify that submitting a selected answer evaluates it, updates the score, deselects previous choices, and loads the next question or final score.

cases.title: Final score display and Play Again functionality
cases.description: Verify that completing all questions displays the final score in the format 'You answered X/Y questions correctly' and renders the 'Play Again' button which reloads the page.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases accurately cover the requirements, provide distinct scenarios, and are fully testable without any blockers.
All cases are clear, well-defined, and properly map to the specified requirements. No blockers were found.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior: Automatic display of the first question and four unchecked radio buttons with correct data-testid attributes ('question', 'answer-a' through 'answer-d', 'answer-a-text' through 'answer-d-text') upon page load. Boundaries: Initial page load state. Normal path: Page loads, first question and options appear, all radios unchecked. Abnormal path: Pre-selected radios on load. Ambiguities: None. R-2: Testable behavior: Mutual exclusivity of answer selection using radio buttons within 'quiz' container, handling rapid clicks/re-selections, and submitting via 'submit-button'. Boundaries: Multiple clicks, changing selection before submission. Normal path: Click radio button, option is selected while others remain deselected. Abnormal path: Rapid or repeated clicks attempting to select multiple options. Ambiguities: None. R-4: Testable behavior: Submit button behavior based on selection state (no-op if unselected; evaluates, updates score, loads next question or final score if selected). Boundaries: Last question submission, zero selection submission. Normal path: Select answer, click submit, advance to next question or end screen. Abnormal path: Click submit with no selection. Ambiguities: None. R-5: Testable behavior: Dynamic score display format 'You answered X/Y questions correctly' in 'quiz', rendering of 'play-again-button' reloading the page, state reset for new sessions. Boundaries: End of quiz transition. Normal path: Final question answered, score displayed, play again button reloads page. Abnormal path: Incorrect state retention after reload. Ambiguities: None. R-6: Testable behavior: Specific initial question ('Which language runs in a web browser?') and specific options ('Java', 'C', 'Python', 'JavaScript') displayed after clicking 'play-again-button'. Boundaries: Post-reload state. Normal path: Click play-again-button, page reloads to initial question with zero score. Abnormal path: Retaining previous score or question index post-reload. Ambiguities: None.
